title: Desk Note — Reading a Plan under the Building Automation Service Plans Together with the Building's Other Cover
content:
# Desk Note — Reading a Plan under the Building Automation Service Plans Together with the Building's Other Cover

A plan under the Building Automation Service Plans sits alongside the rest of the building's cover and the two are read together.

**Maintenance with remote monitoring.** Where the site holds a maintenance agreement whose tier includes remote monitoring, the alarm monitoring of this plan is not billed a second time and the maintenance bundle credit is applied against the maintenance price rather than here.

**An energy subscription reading the same system.** Where an energy monitoring subscription draws its data from the same controls system, the point licence is counted once and carried on this plan, and the energy subscription is not charged per point for the same points. Whether such a subscription exists is read, before any charge is raised, from the office's energy subscription records matched to the building — the subscription at that site, its standing and the source its data is drawn from — rather than from the caller's account of it.

**Faults found across products.** A controls fault found during a maintenance visit is logged as a ticket on this plan and drawn from its support pool, not billed as maintenance work, while mechanical work found during a controls ticket is passed to the maintenance agreement or quoted as demand service.

**A controls upgrade project in progress.** A site holding a controls upgrade project in progress does not hold an automation plan at the same time for the panels the project replaces, and the plan's coverage is amended at the project's close.

Whether the tier includes alarm monitoring, and the licence fee per covered point, are the tier schedule's figures.

## Where a charge or a piece of work lands

| Situation | Landing |
|---|---|
| Alarm monitoring where the site's maintenance tier includes remote monitoring | not billed a second time here; the bundle credit is applied against the maintenance price |
| Points an energy monitoring subscription reads from this controls system | the point licence is counted once and carried on this plan; the subscription is not charged per point for them |
| A controls fault found on a maintenance visit | a ticket on this plan, drawn from its support pool |
| Mechanical work found on a controls ticket | passed to the maintenance agreement or quoted as demand service |
| Panels replaced by a controls upgrade project in progress | not held under an automation plan at the same time; coverage amended at the project's close |
